response_dictionary_fixed_before_y.flow: K_i n_i, K_i=-5/(ln(10) Vcmb_i); coefficient km/s, low-z conditional
response_dictionary_fixed_before_y.STF: five Frobenius-orthonormal n:S_a:n columns; profiled with all baseline nuisance

optical_response_relation.premises: one smooth source/emitter energy congruence, regular low-z vertex, zero shear for displayed scalar law, fixed H>0, 1-q>0, source-pointing n, same frame
optical_response_relation.linearized_delta_mu: (5/ln(10))*q plus O(q^2) and unmeasured finite-z remainder; requires |q|<<1
optical_response_relation.linearized_angular_calibration_equivalen: d.n with d=(5/ln(10))*A/(c*H) mag, only in first-order response columns
optical_response_relation.identifiability: EXACT_ONLY_FOR_LINEARIZED_DESIGN_COLUMNS; finite-q optical response is not a pure dipole; do not jointly estimate d and A from this linearized design
optical_response_relation.linearization_remainder: -5*log10(1-q)-(5/ln(10))*q; second order in q, unbounded by available physical inputs
optical_response_relation.units: A m/s^2, c m/s, H 1/s, d mag; dimensionless ratio multiplied by magnitude coefficient
